harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9), using systemd units bound to each node's real IP (10.100.215.10/11/12) on ports 2379/2380, after opening those ports in firewalld (which was silently blocking peer traffic). Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (quorum preserved) and that the member catches up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential native reboot (shutdown -r now) of all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes: RHEL 9.8, x86_64, no etcd present, sudo and internet available
Downloaded and installed etcd/etcdctl v3.5.17 static binaries to /usr/local/bin on node1, node2, node3
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on node2 and node3 (node1 already had them)
Created etcd system user and /var/lib/etcd data dir on all nodes
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node with correct --name/--listen-peer-urls/--listen-client-urls/--advertise-client-urls/--initial-cluster referencing all three real node IPs
Diagnosed initial bootstrap failure as firewalld blocking 2379/2380 tcp (no route to host on peer port); opened both ports permanently on all three nodes and reloaded firewalld
Cleared stale data dirs and cold-started etcd simultaneously on all three nodes; confirmed 3-member cluster formed and endpoint health OK on all three
Verified a key written on node1 (foo) is readable from node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, confirmed writes/reads still succeed via node1/node2 (quorum maintained), restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up on missed keys and rejoined healthy
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd health baseline on all three nodes

Sequentially restarted node1, then node2, then node3 via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnection; for each: confirmed unreachability during reboot, polled until reachable again, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd active and endpoint healthy, confirmed data (including keys written to the cluster while that node was rebooting) present, confirmed cluster membership intact via member list
Final full-cluster health check across all three real endpoints and full key listing

evidence.summary: etcdctl member list from node1 shows all three members (node1/node2/node3) started with correct peer/client URLs; endpoint health OK

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Key 'foo' put via node1's local endpoint, then successfully read back from node2 and node3's local endpoints with the same value

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write via node1 succeeded and was immediately readable via node2, both endpoints reporting healthy while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; endpoint health OK and it returned the key written while it was offline, confirming resynchronization

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b634b53f.../etcd healthy captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id 608428dc...; post-restart etcd active, endpoint healthy, key 'foo' intact, 3-member list unchanged

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f1afbc7f.../etcd healthy captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id edba4cef...; post-restart etcd active, endpoint healthy, key written during its downtime present, 3-member list unchanged

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 98aa35f5.../etcd healthy captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 3636f517...; post-restart etcd active, endpoint healthy, key written during its downtime present, 3-member list unchanged

evidence.requirement: Full cluster health and data integrity after all three restarts
evidence.summary: All three real-IP endpoints report healthy via a single cluster health check; all keys written throughout the exercise (foo, during-outage, during-node2-reboot, during-node3-reboot) are present
